_comment: No prefix filter, because there is nothing above the owner folders to
filter on: objects are laid out {owner_id}/{event_id}/… at the root of
the bucket. An empty filter is the whole bucket, which is exactly the
intent - every object in here is somebody's photo.
Filters on the object TAG, not the prefix. S3 prefix filters are
literal - there is no way to write */*/archive/ - so a prefix rule
here would expire every photo in the bucket after 30 days.
The ZIP is derived data and can always be rebuilt.
